pregame.pressurePoint: Arkansas State deep passing vs Louisiana secondary. Louisiana is No. 34 of 138 at limiting explosive passes (1.43). Arkansas State ranks No. 113 in pass explosiveness (1.40). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Deep balls are the lowest-percentage play in this game. Arkansas State needs the underneath game and yards after catch. Watch Arkansas State's longest completion. If it is under 25 yards at the half, Louisiana has won the matchup.
